text:
Juno: FYI -- GammaHealth renewal invoice (inv_98453) landed with a weird diff. Platform fee line appears doubled and there's an HSM add-on we never enabled. Sending invoice link: https://invoices.redwood/gamma/98453 :eyes:
Maya: Ugh. can you paste the invoice lines? quick glance would help.
Juno: copy of the relevant section below:
```
- platform_fee_monthly: $45,000
- platform_fee_monthly: $45,000
- support_tier: Enterprise
- hsm_integration: $6,500
```
(Their signed SOW says support: Gold, platform_fee_monthly: $45,000, no HSM)
Suresh: billing system shows two billing_invoices generated for the renewal window because of a migration overlap (renewal_job v2 + legacy_sync). One was supposed to be deduped but the dedupe key failed on the renewal_date field.
Liam: Wait — sales submitted an upgrade request for GammaHealth in Jan, but it was never accepted by customer. I confirmed with CRM: status = proposed, not closed. So support tier should remain Gold.
Ava: Customer wrote to CS this morning confused about the invoice. They've put a hold on payment until clarified.
billing-bot: [automated] invoice inv_98453 created by job renewal_job_v2 at 2256789001. Duplicate candidate: inv_97321. Ticket created: BLG-4820.
Maya: Looks like two action items: 1) remove duplicate platform fee charge, 2) remove HSM line and patch invoice history. Does BLG-4820 track both?
Suresh: BLG-4820 currently references the duplicate detection bug only. I'll add the HSM line investigation. Initial root cause: legacy_sync inserted a feature_flagged line item when it merged add-ons from the legacy account profile.
Juno: We need a proposed remediation and approvals ASAP — customer is waiting and payment is on hold. Estimated correction credit = $45,000 (duplicate PF) + $6,500 (HSM) = $51,500. That exceeds our auto-credit limit.
Maya: For context, our auto-approve credit cap is $25k. >$50k needs finance head approval. @Olivia can you weigh in?
Olivia: Reviewing now. Two quick questions: is there any chance the customer actually agreed to an upgrade or HSM via an oral convo? If yes we need evidence.
Liam: Confirmed: no signed acceptance. CS notes show only a feature request; no POC/PO signed.
Ava: Customer chat transcript attached in their ticket -- no acceptance.
Olivia: OK. Approve provisional adjustment to unblock the customer: issue a temporary credit of $51,500 pending our internal reversal once we fix the invoice pipeline. Finance will need the corrected invoice and a final journal entry.
Maya: I'll create a credit memo and route to accounting. Suresh — please update BLG-4820 with final root cause and steps so we can avoid repeat.
Suresh: Will do. Plan: 1) rollback legacy_sync add-on merge for renewal window 2) add dedupe on (customer_id, renewal_cycle_id, renewal_date) 3) run reconciliation to ensure no other customers impacted. ETA 48 hours.
Juno: I'll notify GammaHealth that we will issue the credit and regenerate a corrected invoice within 48 hours.
billing-bot: [automated] credit memo CM-2259 created for inv_98453 amount $51,500. Ticket BLG-4820 updated.
Ava: Thanks team. I'll send a short note to the customer (no apologies, just corrective note + timeline). :thumbsup:
Maya: tagging for audit: attach the corrected invoice and the JE once done. Also escalate if reconciliation finds >3 affected accounts.
Olivia: Approved. please cc me on the final JE.
Juno: noted — closing loop after fix.
Maya: marking BLG-4820 -> remediation in progress.
Suresh: starting the rollback now. will post a status update at 2256792000.
